text.insert: Working process flow for this band of the global flow. Confirmed detail from the walkthrough accumulates here before mapping to the owning chapter.

steps.text: Enter the PR band on the Run boundary's classification
Require an `active` Cycle, unblocking it first when entry is forced
Walk the eight phases: `final_build`, `qa`, `qa_fixes`, `split`, `prepare_prs`, `publish`, `review`, `intake`
Read the checkpoint dispositions: `pr_candidate` ships, `improvement_candidate` stays local
Fall back to the explicit candidate list, then to every lint-touched file
Nothing in this band re-derives a disposition. It reads what the Run already decided.
Mark PR complete to record the result without closing the Cycle
Scan and review the working tree, then build the repair queue
Run Cycle review with no commit, leaving validated edits in the working tree
Scan the candidate files with the deterministic lint diff, worktree included
Pin `HEAD` once so everything downstream names the same source position
For each changed candidate file, review a one-file slice
For each reviewer rejection, re-read the diff hunk for adversarial confirmation
An unreadable diff, a missing hunk, or any agent or parse error confirms the finding. The pass fails closed.
Merge the survivors, quarantining refuted rejections and headers into the ledger
Build one queue item per candidate source file, with its errors and mandatory warnings
Write the queue, its summary, its report, and the ship status
The chapter says one repair item per finding; code groups findings by source file into one item and keeps per-finding granularity inside the agent's dispositions (bug catalog)
Repair each queued item under the score gate
For each queued item, run one repair pass against one source file
Repair at the source, re-scoring after each target, with a minimal revert as last resort
Report one disposition per finding: fixed, reverted, evidenced, or false positive
Gate the item before calling it clean: re-scan, rebuild, re-snapshot, check in fixed order
Agent output alone can never mark an item clean.
Route to needs-rework on any error, mandatory warning, or failed check
Snapshot every dirty header first, then revert what the agent was not authorized to touch
Repeat the fill-and-wait loop **until** every selected item has run
Build the change set, sending failed targets back to their items, or halting if none owns it
Run the configured regression command, flipping clean files back to needs-rework
Write the ledger: findings tiered, decomp context best-effort, mirrored to a stable path
The job's exit code reflects only agent errors and regression-command infrastructure failures; ledger findings never make it nonzero (bug catalog)
Plan review-sized slices from one stable point
Resolve `HEAD` to one sha that every branch, patch, and isolation command replays from
Refuse a ship filter that names nothing
Collect the branch diff plus the worktree status as one set, dropping permuter scratch
Assign the lanes: new exact matches ship, improvements only above both thresholds
Group by melee subsystem, then support runtimes, then the first path segment
Demote group files outside the verified ship set into the local lane
Pack undersized groups first-fit under the ceiling, splitting oversized ones a level deeper
Classify each slice as shared-prep, stacked, or independent
Nothing is marked verified here. Independence is a proposal, and each slice carries the checks that would prove it in isolation.
Optionally let the splitter agent regroup the deterministic seed
Reject a proposal that drops a seed file, duplicates one, mixes lanes, or busts the ceiling
Verify the ship set at the PR gate
Take the passed plan's match-lane pathspecs, refusing when there are none
Fetch, then pin the base and source refs, voiding the run if either moves
Rebuild the production baseline in a detached worktree at the base sha, cached per sha
Repeat the survivor loop **until** clean or four rounds spent
Apply the ship-set patch onto the baseline, build it, and read the regression report
Lint that tree with upstream CI's check-issues container
Drop each offender's file with its reason and re-verify, or block if it owns no file
Settle as nothing to ship when a clean patch produces no new match
`pr_ready` means exactly what the PRs will contain produces new matches, with zero metric regressions, zero broken matches, zero fuzzy regressions, and zero CI lint issues.
Publish the stamps transactionally on `pr_ready`, then re-plan the slices against them
A missing Docker daemon makes the lint check unavailable, and unavailable passes the gate — only upstream CI catches those issues (bug catalog)
Hand a not-ready ship set to the reconcile agent for one fix loop
Prepare each slice, open its draft, then QA it
Require a ready ship status, an existing patch, and a matching baseline sha
Stamp each record preparing, verify the slice in the baseline, build its worktree
Open drafts in bounded batches, each slice under its own lease
Ensure the baseline, push the branch, re-sync the PR records, post ledger comments
Repeat the draft QA round against the open draft
Review the whole PR as one slice and lint its diff
Hand the merged scan to the same repair lane
Loop **until** the scan is clean, no repair is unresolved, and the reviewer raises nothing
Classify the draft, first match wins: blocked, needs-repair, manual-review, or ready
Post what is left: tier one inline, tier two as one comment, tier three dropped
Review each shipping slice one last time before it ships
For each slice in the plan, read its diff alone with no tools
Inject the deterministic lint findings as evidence
Warn the reviewer when the linter is unavailable, to read with extra suspicion
Return an error verdict on agent, parse, or schema failure — never an approval
Block the ship on any reject or error, including a reject under an approving verdict
Refuse to read an empty or all-skipped selection as approval
Append reviewer-proposed rules to the curator's file as capped-confidence proposals
Open the campaign and publish bounded batches
Require an active Cycle and a fresh source anchor at the Cycle head
Create one series per match slice, branch names unique
Activate the campaign by taking the game's dispatch lease from a Run
Pause that Run or point its drain here, keeping the campaign queued until handover
Write a phase boundary into the Cycle timeline on acquire and on release
Publish a batch on operator confirmation
Publishing is reservation-backed: reserve the batch, claim it, then re-validate the lease and the series right before the external call.
Publish a series only on clean validation, an anchor-matching revision, and no newer invalidation
Open the PR, then commit the series and complete the reservation
Release the lease back to in-review once nothing is revising or in progress
Adopt legacy `codex/split-*` branches instead, each at its observed upstream status
Ride the remote review round-trip, then revise
Stay dormant: in-review with no lease, observing but blocked from fixing or publishing
Ride the PR sync instead of a timer
For each observed PR, ingest the feedback before applying the status transition
Key comments and reviews as work items by source identity so repeat polls dedupe
Ingestion never reads or takes the dispatch lease, which is exactly what lets a dormant campaign keep collecting review.
Fence every fixer command on a working campaign, matching correlation, and a held PR lease
Claim the pending items, moving the series to revising on the first claim
Resolve or decline each claimed item, a decline carrying a required reason
Revise the series once nothing is pending or in progress, then return it to published
Reconcile the slice when it no longer applies, never while a Run is active
Recommend ready, retry, or escalate, writing the summary either way
Recover a stale activation back to in-review, its items back to pending
Record the terminal results, then close or abandon
Write merged and closed as terminal series statuses
Observation writes them, not any operator action.
Close the campaign on operator confirmation
Refuse while any series is unfinished, or while the campaign holds no series at all
Release first when working, so it closes through in-review rather than dropping its lease
Abandon on confirmation without waiting, cancelling revising series and in-progress items
Send merged PRs out of this band through Cycle intake
Create one intake item per PR, with its postmortem and knowledge intake nested beneath
